an10.109:1.1: tikicchakā bhikkhave vamanaṃ denti, pittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ ābādhānaṃ paṭighātāya, semhasamuṭṭhānānampi ābādhānaṃ paṭighātāya, vātasamuṭṭhānānampi ābādhānaṃ paṭighātāya,
an10.109:1.2: atthetaṃ bhikkhave vamanaṃ, netaṃ natthi ti vadāmi.
an10.109:1.3: tañca kho etaṃ bhikkhave vamanaṃ sampajjatipi, vipajjatipi.
an10.109:2.1: ahañca kho bhikkhave ariyaṃ vamanaṃ desissāmi, yaṃ vamanaṃ sampajjatiyeva no vipajjati, yaṃ vamanaṃ āgamma jātidhammā sattā jātiyā parimuccanti, jarādhammā sattā jarāya parimuccanti, maraṇadhammā sattā maraṇena parimuccanti, sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsadhammā sattā sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsehi parimuccanti.
an10.109:3.1: katamañca taṃ bhikkhave ariyaṃ vamanaṃ: yaṃ vamanaṃ sampajjatiyeva no vipajjati, yaṃ vamanaṃ āgamma jātidhammā sattā jātiyā parimuccanti …pe… sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsehi parimuccanti.
an10.109:4.2: ye ca micchādiṭṭhipaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti te cassa vantā honti.
an10.109:4.3: sammādiṭṭhipaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanā pāripūriṃ gacchanti.
an10.109:5.2: sammā vācassa bhikkhave micchāvācā vantā hoti …pe…
an10.109:5.4: …pe… sammā ājīvassa bhikkhave micchāājīvo vanto hoti …pe…
an10.109:6.2: ye ca micchāvimuttipaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti, te cassa vantā honti.
an10.109:6.3: sammāvimuttipaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanā pāripūriṃ gacchanti.
an10.109:6.4: idaṃ kho taṃ bhikkhave ariyaṃ vamanaṃ, yaṃ vamanaṃ sampajjatiyeva no vipajjati, yaṃ vamanaṃ āgamma jātidhammā sattā jātiyā parimuccanti …pe… sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsadhammā sattā sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsehi parimuccantī
